ITEM 1 | Finely chopped bright green leafy vegetable with ragged, frilly edges and pale whitish-green stem fragments, slightly moist with a matte surface, loosely piled in a mound covering roughly 30% of the plate's right half, about 13 cm across and 2 cm tall at its peak, scattered with small loose pieces at the edge | 90

ITEM 2 | Single small pale orange-brown piece with a smooth, slightly glossy surface and a flat cut face, about 2.5 cm by 1.5 cm and 0.8 cm thick, sitting on top of the upper edge of the green mound | 8

ITEM 3 | Thin, pale yellowish-cream fragments with a slightly moist, soft look, scattered sparsely along the lower edge of the green pile, each piece about 0.5 to 1 cm across and under 0.3 cm thick | 4
